title: NotFormatDraft7
description: Issue #185 under a dialect that asserts `format`. {"not":{"type":"string","format":"email"}} forbids e-mail addresses alone; read with the format dropped it forbade every string. plainNot is the control that must still forbid every string.

branchFormat.$comment: The same keyword inside a disallow-style branch, which extractNotSchemaBranches reads by its own gate. Read with the format dropped, the branch became `a string of three characters or more` and refused every one of them.
